# First Deploy

> First Deploy is the after-hours desk and live apps for field operators, built by AgentHive Inc. Setup is $1,500 (live this week or you do not pay), then $250/month.

First Deploy is part of AgentHive Inc in Palm Coast, Florida. Daniel Graham embeds working AI in real operations, then leaves it running. First Deploy is the product. Consulting is how you buy time in the room. Proof from a commercial earth mover.
